summary: Could NOT reproduce the reported 'Failed to send OTP' bug. Backend + UI Super Admin login works end-to-end on both /login and /t/demo. errMsg() fix renders 'Invalid OTP' properly on wrong OTP (no '[object Object]'). Stale localStorage does not break send-OTP. Reviewer bypass + CORS preflight all green. 7/7 backend pytest + 5/5 UI Playwright scenarios PASS.
action_items: No code fixes needed. Original bug is not reproducible on the live preview URL — likely a transient WatchFiles reload or stale JS bundle in the user's browser. Recommend asking the user to hard-reload / try incognito to confirm, and to send exact request/response payload if it recurs.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx errMsg() correctly squashes structured {code, message} details to a string — verified via wrong-OTP path (toast rendered 'Invalid OTP', not '[object Object]').
request-otp endpoint is public and unaffected by stale X-Tenant-Slug / Authorization headers — verified.
Super admin phone short-circuit works regardless of tenant_slug — verified for /t/demo route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/auth/request-otp returns {is_super_admin, mock_otp} correctly. If the user reports the bug again, capture: (a) exact request-otp response payload from Network tab, (b) console.error output (Login.jsx now logs status+response), (c) browser + build hash. UI selectors: [data-testid=phone-input], [data-testid=send-otp-btn], [data-testid=otp-input], [data-testid=verify-otp-btn].
rca_of_the_issue: Reported 'Failed to send OTP' toast could not be reproduced. Backend consistently returns 200 with mock_otp=557725 for the super admin phone across (a) /login, (b) /t/demo, (c) with stale localStorage, (d) with tenant_slug in body. The errMsg() helper in Login.jsx already ensures structured detail errors render as strings rather than '[object Object]'. Most likely root cause of the user's original report: a transient stale JS bundle / mid-hot-reload state during development, which is now moot.
